mapper.insert: INSERT INTO prompt_history ( user_id, category_id, prompt_type, prompt_style, prompt_text, image_url, image_aspect_ratio, purpose, additional_notes, text_content, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{promptType}, #{promptStyle}, #{promptText}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageAspectRatio}, #{purpose}, #{additionalNotes}, #{textContent}, #{initRegiPic}, #{initRegiDttm}, #{finalRvisPic}, #{finalRvisDttm} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, category_id, prompt_type, prompt_style, prompt_text, image_url, image_aspect_ratio, purpose, additional_notes, text_content, init_regi_pic, init_regi_dttm, final_rvis_pic, final_rvis_dttm FROM prompt_history WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE prompt_history SET image_url = #{imageUrl}, final_rvis_pic = #{finalRvisPic}, final_rvis_dttm = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prompt_history WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND init_regi_dttm >= CURRENT_DATE AND init_regi_dttm < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 day'
